purpose: Teach: 緒方/たたえ/東山/江口/徳永/関根/井出/新党

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、緒方氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were younger, you and Ogata-san started that joint venture together.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting tone. Steady pace. Not a question but an invitation to remember. Eyes warm with recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の貢献をたたえる事を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father always believed in acknowledging his employees' contributions.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Each phrase deliberate. A son honoring his father's principle with care and precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、京都東山の老舗料亭で接待された
lines.en: You used to hold business dinners at that old restaurant in Higashiyama, Kyoto.
lines.style: Soft, almost wandering quality. Voice drifts slightly on the place name. A memory made gentle by time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは江口氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father made Eguchi-san the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Slight pause before the name. Speaking as if tracing an important decision with his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、徳永氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: You developed the accounting structure with Tokunaga-san during those early years.
lines.style: Tender cadence. Unhurried. The warmth of recalling a partnership that mattered. Soft trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは関根氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father took Sekine-san under his wing and developed him into a department head.
lines.style: Warm conviction in the voice. Speaking as if passing on something precious. Respectful, grounded, almost protective.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、井出氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were building internationally, you and Ide-san established our overseas operation.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet admiration. Patient, allowing the scope of the accomplishment to settle. Unhurried breathing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新党、つまり新党結成期の動向に詳しかった
lines.en: Yes. Father followed the political currents closely during the new party era.
lines.style: Clear, assured tone. Closing with quiet certainty—the statement of someone who knows what he's saying. Almost sage-like.
